# Uptrix Technologies

Uptrix Technologies is a growth marketing company that builds and runs the full marketing engine for startups, scaleups and SMEs worldwide. One team owns strategy, brand, paid media, SEO, content and performance — from the first growth call to the numbers at the end of the quarter.

## Website

https://uptrixtechnologies.com

## Services

- **Demand Generation** — SEO, AI search optimisation, paid ads, content and lead capture working together as one engine
- **Paid Growth** — Meta, Google and LinkedIn campaigns built for conversion, not vanity metrics
- **Conversion Website** — Websites designed and built to turn visitors into leads and customers
- **Growth Foundation** — Brand positioning, CRM setup, analytics, tracking and marketing infrastructure
- **AI Marketing** — AI-assisted content, creative testing and marketing automation integrated into the growth engine
- **Revenue Operations** — Pipeline management, CRM optimisation and sales-marketing alignment
- **SEO** — Technical SEO, content strategy and authority building for sustainable organic growth
- **Social Media Marketing** — Organic and paid social strategy across Meta, LinkedIn and Instagram
- **PPC / Paid Advertising** — Google Ads, Meta Ads and programmatic media management
- **Branding** — Brand identity, positioning, messaging and visual design
- **AI UGC Video Ads** — AI-assisted user-generated content and video ad creative production
- **Business Automation** — Workflow automation, CRM integration and operational efficiency
- **Fractional CMO** — Senior growth strategy embedded into your business without the full-time cost

## Uptrix 5S Framework

Uptrix 5S is the five-stage engagement model applied to every client:

1. **Scan** — Full audit of market, competitors, audience and current marketing efforts
2. **Strategy** — Growth roadmap, target segments, positioning, channel mix and 90-day priorities
3. **Sequence** — Foundations: brand consistency, CRM, tracking and conversion architecture
4. **Ship** — Campaigns, content, ads, SEO and outreach go live with a tight feedback loop
5. **Scale** — What works gets more resource; what does not gets fixed or replaced
